# h03_invsq_sum

Prove that for every integer $n \ge 1$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{i^2} \le 2 - \frac{1}{n}.$$

The sum is over the real numbers; the bound is tight at $n = 1$.
